settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_ANCHOR_JWKS
settings.description: The pinned trust anchor keys every chain validates to: one JWK Set, for the anchor OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_CONTROLLER_HOST names, or a map of anchor to JWK Set in order of preference; public keys only, each with its own kid

when_wrong.detail: A set with a private or symmetric key, a missing or repeated kid, or PingFederate's own keys beside OIDF_FEDERATION_SELF_ANCHOR: the registration filters do not start

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_SELF_ANCHOR
settings.description: PingFederate's own Entity Identifier, when it is a trust anchor itself: chains ending at it are checked with the key it signs with, read from its key store each time

when_wrong.detail: Not an https URL with a host: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_CONTROLLER_HOST
settings.description: The federation's trust anchor as a bare Entity Identifier: the anchor a single pinned JWK Set belongs to, the one the OGNL criteria and the attestation filter check against, and exempt from the fetch rules

when_wrong.detail: Set with no anchor keys: the registration filters skip automatic registration and the OGNL criteria refuse. Unset, with no anchor map and no self anchor: the token-endpoint filter does not start

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_CONTROLLER_BASE_URL
settings.description: Where the trust controller's own Entity Configuration is fetched, when it is served under a context path; unset, the controller host. Its origin and path prefix are exempt from the fetch rules (https only, no private addresses), as the controller host is

when_wrong.detail: A wrong value shows as failed fetches; an http or private-network value is fetched all the same, because it is exempt

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_IGNORE_SSL_ERRORS
settings.description: Whether federation fetches skip certificate checks, for a test federation only; PDP calls always check

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true, in any case, means false; the superseded name set to a different value stops PingFederate starting

settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTATION_REQUIRE_ATTESTER_BINDING
settings.description: Whether a client whose bridge-key entry names no attesters is refused at the token endpoint (401); false lets any trusted attester vouch for it

when_wrong.detail: Not true or false: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_REQUIRE_METADATA_POLICY
settings.description: Whether a registration whose chain has no superior setting a metadata policy for the role registered is refused (400 invalid_client_metadata)

when_wrong.detail: Not true or false: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_REGISTRATION_MAX_TTL_SECONDS
settings.description: The longest a registration lasts: it ends at its chain's expiry or this, whichever is sooner (12.3)

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number, or below the minimum: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_REGISTRATION_MIN_TTL_SECONDS
settings.description: A chain that would leave a registration less than this registers nothing

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number, negative, or above the maximum: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_REGISTRATION_REFRESH_BEFORE_EXPIRY_SECONDS
settings.description: How long before its end an automatic registration is renewed at the token endpoint

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number, or negative: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_REGISTRATION_EXPIRY_ENFORCEMENT
settings.description: What an expired registration that cannot be renewed meets: refuse, the request is refused; disable, and the client disabled until a renewal; log, the expiry is logged and nothing enforced, the sweeper included. Under the production profile disable and log each need the dated risk expiry-log-mode in OIDF_ACCEPTED_RISKS

when_wrong.detail: Anything but refuse, disable or log, in any case: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_REGISTRATION_SWEEP_INTERVAL_SECONDS
settings.description: How often a background task disables federation clients whose registration has ended; 0 turns it off, and one runs per JVM

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number, or negative: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_AUTO_REGISTRATION_FAIL_CLOSED
settings.description: Whether a request whose automatic registration fails, or whose expired registration cannot be renewed, is refused with the reason rather than passed on to PingFederate

when_wrong.detail: Not true or false: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_AUTO_REGISTRATION_FRONT_CHANNEL
settings.description: Automatic registration of relying parties at the authorization and PAR endpoints (12.1.1); false passes those requests straight through

when_wrong.detail: Not true or false: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_AUTO_REGISTRATION_AUTHZ_ERROR_MODE
settings.description: How a refusal at the authorization endpoint is answered: page, this module's error page and never a redirect; passthrough, the request goes on to PingFederate unregistered

when_wrong.detail: Anything but page or passthrough, in any case: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_ERROR_PAGE
settings.description: An HTML file for the authorization endpoint's error page, with ${error}, ${errorDescription} and ${trackingId}, read once at start-up; unset, a built-in page

when_wrong.detail: Cannot be read: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_AUTO_REGISTRATION_ENCRYPTED_REQUEST_OBJECTS
settings.description: allow: an encrypted request object registers the relying party from its header, and PingFederate checks the rest after decrypting; refuse: such requests are refused

when_wrong.detail: Anything but allow or refuse, in any case: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_AUTO_REGISTRATION_DEFAULT_SCOPES
settings.description: Space-separated scopes for a front-channel relying party whose metadata names none

when_wrong.detail: Registered as given

settings.name: OIDF_AUTO_REGISTRATION_REQUIRE_PAR
settings.description: Whether every front-channel relying party is registered as PAR-only

when_wrong.detail: Not true or false: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_AUTO_REGISTRATION_REQUIRE_PKCE
settings.description: Whether front-channel relying parties are registered requiring PKCE

when_wrong.detail: Not true or false: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_AUTO_REGISTRATION_MAX_REQUEST_OBJECT_BYTES
settings.description: The largest request object or PAR client assertion read at the front channel, in bytes

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number, or below 1: PingFederate does not start. A number past an int wraps before it is checked (F-0198)

settings.name: OIDF_AUTO_REGISTRATION_MAX_CONCURRENT_RESOLUTIONS
settings.description: Chains each registration filter checks at once, the token-endpoint and front-channel filters a pool each; the rest get a 503 with Retry-After

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number, or below 1: PingFederate does not start. A number past an int wraps before it is checked (F-0198)

settings.name: OIDF_AUTO_REGISTRATION_LOCK_WAIT_MS
settings.description: How long a request waits for another registration of the same client in the same filter

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number, or negative: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_REQUIRED_TRUST_MARKS
settings.description: The Trust Marks an entity needs before it registers, by role: {"*": [types], "openid_relying_party": [types]}; the * list applies to every role and each role's list adds to it

when_wrong.detail: Not that shape: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_MARK_STATUS_CHECK
settings.description: Whether a Trust Mark also needs its issuer's status endpoint to say active (8.4), at registration and in resolve responses

when_wrong.detail: Not true or false: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_MARK_TYPES
settings.description: The Trust Mark types PingFederate issues, by type: lifetime_seconds, subjects (hosted or any), delegation, ref and logo_uri, all optional; unset, it issues none

when_wrong.detail: Not that shape, a lifetime that is not positive, or a ref that is not https: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_MARKS
settings.description: Trust Marks other issuers gave PingFederate, carried in its own configuration: a JSON array of {"trust_mark_type", "trust_mark"}

when_wrong.detail: Not that shape, or a mark whose type does not match: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_MARK_ISSUERS
settings.description: As an anchor, who may issue each Trust Mark type: {"<type>": [entity ids]}, [] for anyone; PingFederate adds itself for the types it issues

when_wrong.detail: Not that shape: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_MARK_OWNERS
settings.description: As an anchor, who owns each Trust Mark type: {"<type>": {"sub": entity id, "jwks": {...}}}

when_wrong.detail: Not that shape: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_HISTORICAL_KEYS
settings.description: Whether PingFederate records its signing key at each start and publishes the ones it retired at /federation/historical_keys (8.7)

when_wrong.detail: Not true or false, or starting while signing with a revoked key: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_KEY_HISTORY_GRACE_SECONDS
settings.description: How long a retired key still vouches for what it signed before it was retired

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number, or negative: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_AUTHORITY_METADATA_POLICY
settings.description: The metadata policy every hosted agent's Subordinate Statement starts from, by role; an agent's own policy can only narrow it

when_wrong.detail: Not a valid policy, or not one well-formed JSON object: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_SUBORDINATE_CONSTRAINTS
settings.description: The constraints (6.2) on every Subordinate Statement PingFederate issues: max_path_length, naming_constraints, allowed_entity_types

when_wrong.detail: Not valid constraints, federation_entity in allowed_entity_types included: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_ENDPOINT_AUTH
settings.description: Which federation endpoints take private_key_jwt client authentication (8.8), each none, optional or required; an endpoint not named takes none

when_wrong.detail: Not that shape, an endpoint that is not one, or set without trust anchors: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_ENDPOINT_AUTH_SIGNING_ALGS
settings.description: What a client may sign its endpoint assertion with, and what the Entity Configuration advertises, space- or comma-separated

when_wrong.detail: An algorithm that is not an asymmetric JWS one: PingFederate does not start, even with endpoint authentication off

settings.name: OIDF_PDP_MODE
settings.description: Who decides federation requests: off, nobody; local, only OIDF_REGISTRATION_ALLOWED_SCOPES; authzen, that and then the AuthZEN PDP

when_wrong.detail: Anything else, or authzen with no URL: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_PDP_URL
settings.description: The PDP's base URL and identifier; it is asked at /access/v1/evaluation under it unless discovered

when_wrong.detail: Not https with a host (http only with OIDF_FETCH_ALLOW_HTTP=true): PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_PDP_EVALUATION_URL
settings.description: The AuthZEN evaluation endpoint itself, when it is not at the default path; wins over the URL and discovery

when_wrong.detail: Not https with a host (http only with OIDF_FETCH_ALLOW_HTTP=true): PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_PDP_DISCOVER
settings.description: Whether the evaluation endpoint is read from the PDP's /.well-known/authzen-configuration, whose policy_decision_point must equal OIDF_PDP_URL

when_wrong.detail: Not true or false, or true without OIDF_PDP_URL: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_PDP_AUTH
settings.description: How this deployment authenticates to the PDP: none, bearer (Authorization: Bearer) or header (the token in OIDF_PDP_AUTH_HEADER)

when_wrong.detail: Anything else, or bearer or header with no token: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_PDP_AUTH_TOKEN
settings.description: The bearer token or shared secret OIDF_PDP_AUTH sends

when_wrong.detail: The PDP refuses every call, which counts as no decision

settings.name: OIDF_PDP_AUTH_HEADER
settings.description: The header the shared secret goes in, for OIDF_PDP_AUTH=header

when_wrong.detail: The PDP refuses every call, which counts as no decision

settings.name: OIDF_PDP_FAIL_OPEN
settings.description: With no decision from the PDP: false refuses (503); true goes ahead without narrowing and logs federation.pdp.failopen

when_wrong.detail: Not true or false: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_PDP_UNKNOWN_CONTEXT
settings.description: ignore, or reject: a permit carrying context this deployment does not understand is treated as a denial

when_wrong.detail: Anything but ignore or reject, in any case: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_PDP_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
settings.description: How long the PDP's answers are kept - permits and denials, never failures; 0 keeps none

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number, or negative: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_PDP_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS
settings.description: How long to wait to connect to the PDP

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number above 0: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_PDP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
settings.description: How long to wait for the PDP's answer

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number above 0: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_PDP_SURFACE_USER_REASON
settings.description: Whether a refused client is shown the PDP's reason_user

when_wrong.detail: Not true or false: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_PDP_DECISION_POINTS
settings.description: Where the PDP is asked, space- or comma-separated: explicit_registration, automatic_registration, hosted_entity_enrol, token_issuance

when_wrong.detail: A name that is not one of the four: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_REGISTRATION_ALLOWED_SCOPES
settings.description: This deployment's own policy: every registration is narrowed to these scopes, space- or comma-separated; unset, no limit

when_wrong.detail: Set beside OIDF_PDP_MODE=off, or a list of nothing: PingFederate does not start

settings.name: OIDF_BRIDGE_SIGNER_BACKING
settings.description: Where per-client bridge keys come from: vault, OpenBao transit keys; config, inline JWKs, for development; unset, no bridge signing is configured

when_wrong.detail: Anything else, or keys the backing cannot use: that client's token requests fail (500)

settings.name: OIDF_BRIDGE_SIGNING_KEYS
settings.description: The JSON file mapping each client id to its bridge key: {"key_ref": ...} for vault, {"jwk": {...}} for config

when_wrong.detail: Missing, unreadable or not that shape: token requests that need a bridge key fail (500)

settings.name: OIDF_BRIDGE_VAULT_ADDR
settings.description: OpenBao's address, for the vault backing

when_wrong.detail: Wrong: token requests that need a bridge key fail (500)

settings.name: OIDF_BRIDGE_VAULT_TOKEN
settings.description: The OpenBao token, for the vault backing

when_wrong.detail: Refused: token requests that need a bridge key fail (500)
